opportunities.eligibility: 13+; students; open internationally subject to restrictions

opportunities.name: HackMIT 2026
opportunities.description: MIT’s premier student-run global hackathon bringing together over 1,000 top undergraduate engineers, designers, and innovators for 36 hours of building groundbreaking AI, systems, and hardware projects.
opportunities.eligibility: Currently enrolled undergraduate students from accredited universities worldwide. High school seniors may apply upon special petition.

opportunities.name: Google Gemini Multimodal AI Sprint
opportunities.description: Global virtual challenge challenging teams to create innovative applications utilizing Gemini 3 multimodal capabilities, spatial audio, and agentic workflows.
opportunities.eligibility: Open to all students, recent graduates, and independent software builders globally. Free entry.

opportunities.name: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026
opportunities.description: The world’s largest annual space & science hackathon utilizing open NASA satellite, climate, and deep space exploration telemetry data to solve pressing terrestrial challenges.
opportunities.eligibility: No restrictions. Anyone with a passion for problem-solving: students, scientists, developers, storytellers.
opportunities.prizePool: Global NASA Winner Trophy & Kennedy Space Center Invitation

opportunities.name: ETHGlobal San Francisco
opportunities.description: Premier decentralized systems and smart contract engineering weekend bringing together top blockchain protocol architects, cryptography researchers, and frontend developers.
opportunities.eligibility: Open to student and professional developers globally. Travel stipends available for accepted student teams.

opportunities.name: CalHacks 13.0
opportunities.description: The world’s largest collegiate hackathon hosted at UC Berkeley’s historic Pauley Ballroom. Featuring venture mentors from Silicon Valley, top tech recruiters, and bleeding-edge hardware labs.
opportunities.eligibility: All college/university students with valid student IDs.

opportunities.name: Jane Street Electronic Trading Challenge
opportunities.description: A 24-hour algorithmic trading competition where participants write high-frequency market-making bots that execute orders in a simulated live financial exchange.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate and Master’s students graduating between Dec 2026 and June 2028.

opportunities.name: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2027 Global Prelude
opportunities.description: Global student technology competition empowering student entrepreneurs to build high-impact tech startups with Azure AI, OpenAI models, and cloud computing.
opportunities.eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university.

opportunities.name: Hack The North 2026
opportunities.description: Canada’s biggest collegiate hackathon hosting 1,500 students from 30+ countries. 36 hours of non-stop mentorship, industry workshops, and gear.
opportunities.eligibility: High school, undergraduate, and graduate students worldwide.

opportunities.name: OpenAI Developer Day Student Hack
opportunities.description: Build novel agentic architectures, real-time voice applications, and reasoning pipelines directly leveraging next-generation frontier intelligence models.
opportunities.eligibility: All university students enrolled in STEM or design degrees.

opportunities.name: CyberDefense Inter-Collegiate CTF
opportunities.organization: National Cyber Security Center & Carnegie Mellon Cylab
opportunities.description: Intense 48-hour offensive & defensive Capture The Flag (CTF) tournament covering binary exploitation, kernel reverse engineering, cryptographic attacks, and zero-day defense.
opportunities.eligibility: Enrolled university students with .edu or institutional email verification.

opportunities.name: AI Research Scientist Intern - Frontier Reasoning
opportunities.description: Join DeepMind’s core reasoning and agent research lab in London or Mountain View. You will collaborate with staff scientists on frontier reinforcement learning from human feedback, mathematical reasoning, and multimodal pretraining.
opportunities.eligibility: PhD or Master’s students in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or Physics with strong publication track record in NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR.

opportunities.name: Systems Infrastructure Engineering Intern
opportunities.description: Architect and scale high-throughput, five-nines availability payment rails processing hundreds of billions of dollars. Work on distributed transaction ledgers, Kubernetes infrastructure, and observability tooling.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduates graduating Winter 2026 or Spring 2027 pursuing CS, Computer Engineering, or related technical degrees.

opportunities.name: Autopilot Vision & Neural Network Intern
opportunities.description: Train high-capacity 3D reconstruction and temporal occupancy networks running on Tesla HW4/HW5 inference chips. Solve dense scene understanding and trajectory planning in real-time.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate or Graduate students with proven expertise in 3D computer vision and deep learning optimization.

opportunities.name: Quantitative Research & Strategy Intern
opportunities.description: Work alongside quantitative traders and mathematicians to analyze massive historical financial market datasets, build predictive statistical models, and design automated trading strategies.
opportunities.location: New York, NY / Hong Kong / London
opportunities.eligibility: Enrolled undergraduate or graduate students with strong mathematical background (IMO/Putnam background strongly valued).

opportunities.name: Full Stack Product Engineering Intern
opportunities.description: Help build the next generation of Next.js, AI SDK, and edge compute platforms used by millions of developers across the globe. Focus on developer experience, rendering performance, and edge caching.
opportunities.eligibility: Enrolled university students graduating between Fall 2026 and Summer 2028.

opportunities.name: Kernel & Distributed Systems Intern
opportunities.description: Work on Darwin kernel internals, high-performance NVMe storage stacks, and low-level virtualization hypervisors running on Apple Silicon M-series processors.
opportunities.eligibility: B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering.

opportunities.name: Robotics Perception & Control Intern
opportunities.description: Develop dynamic balance, obstacle avoidance, and manipulation policies for Spot and Atlas humanoid robots working in industrial and disaster response environments.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate juniors, seniors, and graduate students in Robotics, Mechanical, or Computer Engineering.

opportunities.name: Hardware Accelerated AI Intern
opportunities.description: Optimize extreme-scale LLM training algorithms for next-gen Blackwell GPU clusters and NVLink network topologies. Implement custom CUDA kernels and GEMM routines.
opportunities.eligibility: Master’s or PhD students with strong parallel computing coursework or projects.

opportunities.name: Data Science & Market Analytics Intern
opportunities.description: Uncover insights across 600M+ active music and podcast streaming users. Build causal inference models and recommendation scoring algorithms powering Discover Weekly.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate or graduate students enrolled in statistics, data science, economics, or engineering.

opportunities.name: Cybersecurity Threat Detection Intern
opportunities.description: Analyze nation-state cyber threat actors, reverse engineer evasive ransomware payloads, and train automated anomaly detection graph models on endpoint telemetry.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate or master’s students majoring in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or Information Assurance.

opportunities.name: Foundation Model Alignment & Safety Fellowship
opportunities.description: Conduct foundational research at Stanford Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM) under leading faculty. Projects investigate mechanistic interpretability, red-teaming safety evaluations, and hallucination reduction in reasoning models.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduates, Master’s students, or recent graduates intending to pursue PhD research. Open globally.
opportunities.professor: Prof. Percy Liang & Prof. Dan Jurafsky
opportunities.funding: Fully Funded ($32,000 Stipend + Campus Housing Grant)

opportunities.name: CERN Openlab Summer Student Research Program
opportunities.description: Work with the world’s leading particle physicists and computer engineers at CERN in Geneva. Develop novel high-performance data processing pipelines and quantum machine learning algorithms for Large Hadron Collider (LHC) particle collision data.
opportunities.eligibility: Bachelor or Master students having completed at least 3 years of full-time university studies in Computer Science or Physics.
opportunities.professor: Dr. Alberto Di Meglio (Head of CERN openlab)
opportunities.funding: CHF 90/day living allowance + Comprehensive Health Insurance & Travel

opportunities.name: MIT CSAIL Distributed Systems Research Assistantship
opportunities.organization: MIT Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
opportunities.description: Join the Parallel & Distributed Operating Systems group at CSAIL. Research fault-tolerant consensus protocols, formal verification of distributed key-value stores, and decentralized state machines.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate or master’s students with strong operating systems and concurrent programming background.
opportunities.professor: Prof. Robert Morris & Prof. Frans Kaashoek
opportunities.funding: Hourly Academic Research Rate ($28/hr, 20 hrs/week) or Full Tuition Credit

opportunities.name: Berkeley AI Research (BAIR) Visiting Student Scholar
opportunities.description: Focus on robot learning, physical dexterity, and deep visual-tactile reinforcement learning. Experiment with physical robotic arms and simulated IsaacGym physics engines.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate seniors and graduate students globally. Prior ML coursework required.
opportunities.professor: Prof. Sergey Levine & Prof. Pieter Abbeel

opportunities.name: Harvard Quantum Computing & Optics Research Project
opportunities.description: Investigate neutral atom arrays, Rydberg quantum simulators, and topological quantum error correction codes. Bridge theoretical quantum information theory with experimental laser cooling apparatus.
opportunities.eligibility: Students majoring in Physics, Math, Electrical Engineering, or CS with quantum mechanics coursework.
opportunities.professor: Prof. Mikhail Lukin & Prof. Susanne Yelin
opportunities.researchArea: Neutral Atom Quantum Simulation & Quantum Error Correction
opportunities.funding: $7,000 Summer Research Stipend + Harvard Yard Housing

opportunities.name: Carnegie Mellon Robotics Institute Summer Scholars (RISS)
opportunities.description: World-renowned 11-week intensive summer research immersion program pairing top undergraduates with CMU robotics faculty to author academic publications and build autonomous systems.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate students worldwide from diverse backgrounds. Women and underrepresented minorities in STEM strongly encouraged to apply.
opportunities.professor: Dr. John Dolan (Director RISS) & RI Faculty
opportunities.funding: Full scholarship covering lodging, food, travel, and research supplies ($6,500 total value)

opportunities.name: Oxford Computational Neuroscience & Brain-Computer Research
opportunities.organization: University of Oxford Department of Physiology
opportunities.description: Decipher motor cortex neural spiking signals during motor planning using high-density Neuropixels electrophysiology recordings and recurrent neural network modeling.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate seniors, master’s students, or clinical medical scholars.
opportunities.professor: Prof. Timothy Behrens & Prof. Gero Miesenböck
opportunities.funding: £18,000 annual research bursary + College dining rights

opportunities.name: Max Planck Institute for Software Systems Student Fellowship
opportunities.description: Collaborate with world-class faculty in Saarbrücken and Kaiserslautern on computer security, provably correct cryptographic protocols, and algorithmic fairness in decision systems.
opportunities.eligibility: Enrolled Bachelor or Master students in Computer Science or Mathematics from any university globally.
opportunities.professor: Prof. Peter Druschel & Prof. Rupak Majumdar
opportunities.institution: Max Planck Institute for Software Systems
opportunities.funding: €1,200/month stipend + Free student residence apartment & travel costs

opportunities.name: Princeton NLP & Reasoning Lab Research Assistant
opportunities.description: Investigate tree-of-thought reasoning, multi-step logical deduction, and tool augmentation for autonomous coding agents under leading faculty in Princeton, NJ.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate juniors/seniors with strong software engineering and machine learning proficiency.
opportunities.professor: Prof. Danqi Chen & Prof. Karthik Narasimhan
opportunities.researchArea: Reasoning, Agentic Workflows & Natural Language Understanding

opportunities.name: Allen Institute for AI (AI2) Pre-doctoral Fellowship
opportunities.description: One-year immersive research fellowship aimed at students planning to apply to top PhD programs. Work on OLMo (Open Language Model) architectures, multimodal reasoning, and open science datasets.
opportunities.eligibility: Graduating seniors or Master’s recipients planning to enter PhD programs in 2028.
opportunities.professor: Dr. Ali Farhadi & OLMo Core Team
opportunities.funding: $95,000 annual salary + Comprehensive Benefits + Travel to NeurIPS/ACL

opportunities.name: Agentic AI Systems & Multi-Agent Hackathon
opportunities.description: Construct cooperative multi-agent workflows solving complex reasoning problems using Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Amazon Bedrock.
opportunities.eligibility: Open to university students and independent developers worldwide.

opportunities.name: NSF REU: Scalable Cyber-Physical Security for Smart Grids
opportunities.description: 10-week summer undergraduate research experience in cybersecurity, automated intrusion detection, and SCADA protection for power grids.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate students who are US citizens or permanent residents enrolled in STEM programs.
opportunities.funding: $7,000 summer stipend + On-campus housing & meal plan

opportunities.name: PennApps XXVI Global Hackathon
opportunities.description: The nation’s original collegiate hackathon held in Philadelphia, focused on hardware builds, web engineering, and enterprise AI.
opportunities.eligibility: All collegiate students.

opportunities.name: Quantitative Technology Summer Analyst
opportunities.description: Build algorithmic execution tools, low-latency risk pricing engines, and real-time data visualizers for institutional fixed income desks.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate students graduating in Dec 2027 or May 2028.

opportunities.name: MIT CSAIL Vision & Language Grant Fellowship
opportunities.description: Undergraduate research on cross-modal video reasoning and grounding large multimodal models with physical robotic sensor streams.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate researchers with experience in deep learning frameworks.
